Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does — they fix their own nitrogen — so I will save my FISP coupon fertilizer for my maize plots where it matters more. I will plant seed I saved from last season, and work the plot myself with my family. Money is tight, so I cannot afford pesticides or hired labor for such a small bean plot.
